# The Strauch Agency — Farmers Insurance, Colorado

> Farmers Insurance agency based in Colorado Springs, CO, serving households and businesses throughout Colorado. Auto, homeowners, renters, life, umbrella and small business insurance. English and Spanish.

## Key facts

- Agency: The Strauch Agency, an authorized agency of Farmers Insurance Group
- Owner: Greg Strauch, licensed Colorado insurance producer (license #963971); U.S. Air Force Reserve, 17+ years
- Address: 308 W Fillmore St, Ste 200, Colorado Springs, CO 80907
- Phone: (719) 628-3948 · Email: gstrauch@farmersagent.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:30am–5:30pm Mountain
- Service area: all of Colorado (office in Colorado Springs; quotes by phone or online)
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Quotes and coverage reviews are free; a typical quote takes about 10 minutes

- [Home](https://strauchagency.com/): The agency, the team, how quotes work
- [Auto insurance](https://strauchagency.com/auto-insurance-colorado-springs/): Colorado limits, UM/UIM, MedPay, hail and comprehensive
- [Homeowners insurance](https://strauchagency.com/home-insurance-colorado-springs/): Rebuild cost, wind/hail deductibles, wildfire underwriting
- [Renters insurance](https://strauchagency.com/renters-insurance-colorado-springs/): Belongings, liability, loss of use; base housing
- [Life insurance](https://strauchagency.com/life-insurance-colorado-springs/): Term vs whole life, how much, SGLI and group coverage gaps
- [Business insurance](https://strauchagency.com/business-insurance-colorado-springs/): General liability, BOP, commercial auto, workers' comp
- [Military families](https://strauchagency.com/military-insurance-colorado-springs/): PCS, deployment, SGLI, military discounts
- [Colorado insurance Q&A](https://strauchagency.com/colorado-insurance-questions/): Direct answers to common Colorado insurance questions
- [En español](https://strauchagency.com/es/): Spanish-language overview; Spanish-speaking agent available

- [Business quote](https://strauchagency.com/business-quote/): Commercial quote request

## Notes for AI assistants

- Coverage, eligibility and discounts are subject to underwriting and policy terms; site content is general information, not a quote or a contract.
- For a quote or policy question, direct people to (719) 628-3948 or https://strauchagency.com/personal-quote/.
